description: FRAME KIS query set — real VBS2021 typed team queries over V3C1, decomposed into a semantic part + structured filter predicates.
_bumping: MAJOR: a query's meaning changed, items removed, or GT recomputed under different parameters (prior results void). MINOR: items added only (prior results still valid on the shared items). PATCH: nothing result-affecting (notes, status, verified flags). build.py warns if the contents changed but this version did not.
